categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches `src/node/blockstorage` availability checks and carries the maintainer 'Block storage' label.
categories.rationale: Prevents potential assertion crashes in `GetFirstBlock` when partial masks match and corrects availability handling for genesis undo data. According to the PR description, 'GetFirstBlock requires every requested bit, so a partial match can reach its assertion' and genesis handling could improperly accept missing block data or reject valid undo requests.
